# Getting Started

Replace this content with your own notes. The layout flows automatically
across the configured number of columns.

- Use `#` for top-level sections and `##` for subsections
- Standard Markdown works: **bold**, *italic*, `code`, lists, and tables
- Math macros such as $\NN$, $\ZZ$, and $\RR$ are available

# Callouts

::: tipp
Tips are rendered as blue callout blocks.
:::

::: {.warnung title="Important"}
Warnings are rendered in red and can have a custom title.
:::

::: default
The `default` class renders a neutral gray callout.
:::

# Theorems

::: theorem
Every theorem is numbered automatically within its section.
:::

::: {.definition title="Natural numbers"}
The natural numbers are defined as $\NN = \{1, 2, 3, \dots\}$.
:::

# Further Reading

See `examples/example.qmd` for a complete showcase of all callouts, theorem
environments, and formatting options.
